caribbean.headline: Caribbean Winds Rise
caribbean.paragraph: Roatan is experiencing 75% rain probability with winds up to 23 kt and wave heights reaching 5.7 ft, while Barbados has a less than 10% rain probability with winds at 16 kt. I expect the strong easterly winds to continue affecting these ports, with the Western Caribbean seeing the most significant impact from the tropical moisture.

mediterranean.headline: Mediterranean Conditions: Mykonos
mediterranean.paragraph: Mykonos in the Eastern Mediterranean is the highest-impact location in the Mediterranean this period, with light winds and seas building to 6.8 ft with ENE swell at 7s periods. less than 10% rain probability -- overall conditions are favorable for cruise operations.
